notes.title: Shakedown Tactics Update
notes.content:
Attention, Debt Enforcers!

Our first major update has just arrived! We’re thrilled to share the "Shakedown Tactics Update" with you all!

1. New Mechanics
Take your audits to the next level with Asset Declarations! Dive deep into the lives of debtors to ensure every cent of taxes is properly accounted for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642305/888f11e67676e3093d5975ca6ad2dddb87fb1794.png
Plus, we’re introducing the Evidence Folder, a collection of information gathered by our highly dedicated inspectors. Knowledge is power, and these tools will make debtors think twice before messing with our essential collections department!


2. Overhauled Timer System
We’ve revamped the call timer mechanics. The timer now runs continuously during calls, making time management critical as you sift through ever-growing piles of debtor information. The challenge ramps up as the game progresses—but don’t worry! This feature can be disabled anytime for a more relaxed experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642305/b0e34d92e780cef840fe555b9a1ec51190e1a0e1.png

This update was shaped by your feedback, and we’re excited to see how you’ll use these new tools in action!

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=samUdzWpSnI;full][/previewyoutube]

 🔍Moral Choices at Every Turn
Navigate the delicate balance between upholding your duties and maintaining your integrity. Will you extract taxes at any cost, or dare to challenge the status quo?

 🌍Branching Narrative and Multiple Endings
Progress through roguelite-style sessions, with various narrative paths and different endings accessed based on your actions, decisions, and overall approach.

 🎮Rich Content
Featuring a vast array of handcrafted personal cases and many more generated through an innovative case generation system. Each narrative line also includes a variety of minigames, activities, and story scenes. There are many hours of gameplay to experience everything the game has to offer.

🚨 Get Ready for the Launch
Add Debtors' Club to your wishlist and hop into our Discord to get the latest news and join the conversation with our community! We’re eager to share this adventure with you and can’t wait for you to dive into the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2411560/Debtors_Club/

See you at the launch!
